RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Male Chinese wounded by pistol shot at 730
Dixwell Road, C.O.I.

At 12 noon on the 8-12-36, acting on the
instructions of the D.D.O. "C" Division, who had received
information that a male Chinese has been shot at No. 730
Dixwell Road, C.O.I., and had been admitted to the Foo
Ming Hospital, enquiries were made by D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo,
J.D.S. 51 Hasuo and the undersigned which resulted in it
being ascertained, that at about 8.30 a.m. on the 8-12-36,
a coolie named Nyi Siau Sz (〔此处转录不清〕), aged 24 years,
employed at 730 Dixwell Road, a Japanese boarding house,
was wounded by a shot fired from a .25 pistol, which was
being cleaned by Corp. Hikide, attached to the Military
Police, of the Japanese Naval Landing Party, in the front
room of the ground floor. Corp. Hikide immediately
removed the victim to the Foo Ming Hospital by a public
ricsha.

The following certificate was issued by the Foo
Ming Hospital.

"A bullet wound in left back, not serious."

The victim, questioned by D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo,
stated at about 8.30 a.m. on the 8-12-36, he was brushing
the front verandah of 730 Dixwell Road, when he received
a bullet wound in his back, which bullet came from the
pistol being cleaned by Corp. Hikide.

J.D.S. 51 Hasuo ascertained that Corp. Hikide
has boarded in 730 Dixwell Road for the past two months.

“左背部枪伤，不严重。”

MALE CHINESE
WOUNDED BY
PISTOL SHOT.
〔此处转录不清〕

At 12 Noon, 8-12-36, D.D.O."C" Div. informed this
Station to the effect that a Chinese male had been shot
at No.730 Dixwell Road and had been removed to the Foo
Ming Hospital. Enquiries made ascertained that at about
8.30.a.m. 8-12-36, a coolie named Nyi Siau Sz, aged 24 years,
employed at No.730 Dixwell Road, a Japanese boarding house,
was wounded by a shot fired from a .25 calibre automatic
pistol which was being cleaned by Corporal Hikide, attached
to the Military Police, of the Japanese Naval Landing Party.
It appears that at the time stated above the coolie was
brushing the front verandah of 730 Dixwell Road, when he was
accidently shot in the back by a bullet which came from the
pistol of Corp. Hikide, who was cleaning same at the time,
and he having forgotten to eject a round from the breech
after removing the magazine when he pressed the trigger.
Corporal Hikide immediately removed the victim to the Foo Ming
Hospital by public ricsha.
Doctor's certificate states:- "A bullet wound in left
back. Not serious."
Captain Tsukamoto, i/c of Military Police informed who
in turn informed the Public Safety Bureau 10.a.m. 8-12-36.

Morning Translation

December 9, 1936.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers :-

JAPANESE GENDARMERIE INJURIES A CHINESE COOLIE : ACCIDENTAL DISCHARGE OF GUN

At 8 a.m December 8, Se Chi Nyien ( 單其年 ), a Chinese in the employ of a Japanese living at No. 730 Dixwell Road near North Szechuen Road, was accidentally shot in the back when Corporal Egasa of the Japanese Military Police, an inmate of the house, was cleaning his pistol. The injured man was removed to Foo Min Hospital for treatment.

Last evening, our reporter called on Ze Chi Nyien at Foo Min Hospital, who said:- "When Corporal Egasa produced his pistol, he said to me jokingly 'I am going to shoot you'. The gun accidentally went off and I was wounded."

The doctors will remove the bullet to-day. The man is in no danger.

It is learned that Corporal Egasa has paid frequent visits to the hospital to console the man.

Lih Pao :-

AMERICAN CHARGED WITH FATAL ASSAULT ON A RICKSHA COOLIE

With reference to the case in which a ricsha coolie named Sung Vei Yui ( 孙维雨 ) was fatally assaulted by Mr. J. Reed Martin, an American youth, the U.S. Court for China has dismissed the charge against the American youth.

A responsible member of the Public Safety Bureau made the following statement to our reporter on December 8 :- "The Public Safety Bureau on December 8 made a report to the Shanghai City Government giving all the particulars in the case including the examination by the Court and the judgment of the U.S. Court for China. The City Government will decide whether or not negotiations are to be opened over the affair".

Lih Pao :-

EMPLOYEES OF S.M.P. DISSATISFIED WITH RETRENCHMENT MEASURES

The employees of the S.M.P. are dissatisfied with the retrenchment measures recently promulgated by the Shanghai Municipal Council.

A few days ago, Major F.W. Gerrard, Commissioner of Police, held a meeting with representatives of various police stations to discuss the matter. The Commissioner will submit his views to the Council.

日前，警务处长F.W. Gerrard少校与各捕房代表举行会议讨论此事。处长将向工部局提交其意见。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

**Pistol bullet fired accidentally by Japanese Marine wounding Chinese amah.**

At 6.10 p.m. on the 1-10-36, a telephone message was received at this station from Mrs. Pintos, Flat 6, Ramos Apartments, 193A North Szechuen Road, reporting a person had been wounded there by a bullet.

Officer i/c, Senior Detective i/c, D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo, C.D.Cs. 119 and 132 and the undersigned immediately attended.

Enquiries by Senior Detective, D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo and the undersigned ascertained that at about 6.05 p.m. a bullet pierced the front window of Flat 6, on the third floor of Ramos Apartments, penetrated a book case and struck the back of a chair, and then struck an amah, named Wong Zung Sz (王陳氏), on the right buttock.

The amah was removed to the Shanghai Sanitorium Clinic, Range Road, by the Shanghai Fire Brigade, Emergency Ambulance and the following certificate was issued.

"Superfluous bullet wound."

She was not detained.

The bullet, after striking the amah, struck a wall near the floor, and was found by the undersigned underneath an easy chair.

The bullet is a .32 of an automatic pistol.

Flat 6 is occupied by Mr. and Mrs. Endaya of Spanish nationality.

**日本水兵意外开枪击伤华籍女佣。**

1936年10月1日下午6时10分，本捕房接到北四川路193A号拉莫斯公寓（Ramos Apartments）6室Pintos夫人的电话报告，称有人在那里被子弹击伤。

THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, OCTOBER 2, 1936

Chinese Woman Shot By Bullet
Of Passing Nippon Bluejacket

A Chinese woman, employed as an amah by Mr. B. J. Endaya, 193 North Szechuen Road, was wounded yesterday afternoon by a bullet fired from the pistol of a Japanese Naval Landing Party member.

Although the shooting was said to be accidental by Nipponese Naval officials, the incident was last night being investigated by the detectives of the Dixwell Road Station.

At the time when she was wounded, the woman, Mrs. Wang Hu-sze, was working in the apartment of Mr. Endaya on the third floor of the Ramos Apartment, North Szechuen Road. The missile pierced her hip and caused a painful, though not serious, injury.

She was conveyed to the Shanghai Sanitarium Clinic, Range Road, where the bullet was extracted. The slug was last night in the hands of the Dixwell Road Station detectives who were investigating the case.

The shooting, according to the explanation made by the Japanese, occurred when the pistol of a bluejacket, who was riding on a patrol truck on North Szechuen Road, accidentally went off. The incident, with the already tense situation in Hongkew, caused considerable commotion in the area. After the shot was fired, Japanese with drawn pistols, alighted from their truck and went upstairs to the Ramos Apartment to investigate the affair.

Rumors that another Japanese was killed gained immediate circulation among the frightened populace. Later information that a woman was wounded by a Japanese bluejacket, however, allayed the general fear.

《字林西报》，1936年10月2日，星期五

中国妇女被过路日本水兵子弹击中

受雇于北四川路193号 B. J. 恩达亚（B. J. Endaya）先生的一名中国女佣，昨日下午被一名日本海军陆战队成员用手枪射出的子弹击伤。

尽管日本海军官员称此次射击为意外事件，但狄思威路警署的侦探昨晚正在对此事进行调查。

受伤时，该女子王胡氏（Wang Hu-sze）正在北四川路拉莫斯公寓三楼恩达亚先生的公寓内工作。子弹穿透其臀部，造成痛苦但非严重的伤害。

她被送往兰路上海疗养院诊所，子弹已被取出。这颗弹头昨晚在负责调查此案的狄思威路警署侦探手中。

据日本人解释，枪击发生在北四川路上一名乘坐巡逻卡车的日本水兵的手枪意外走火时。这一事件，加上虹口地区原本紧张的局势，在该地区引起了相当大的骚动。枪响后，几名手持出鞘手枪的日本人从卡车上下来，上楼进入拉莫斯公寓调查此事。

有关另一名日本人被杀死的谣言在惊恐的民众中迅速流传。然而，后来得知是一名妇女被日本水兵打伤的消息，平息了普遍的恐惧。

My name is Fung Yung Chih, age 28, Yangchow, Postman No.
659 attached to Bubbling Well Office.

I left Bubbling Well Post Office shortly after 12 noon
1/10/36 (off duty) and whilst cycling north along Kiaochow Road

group of persons on the west pavement of Kiaochow Road opposite

Marine who was in this group holding a rifle. I had just passed
the Shanghai Water Works watchman when I heard the shot. I then
dismounted from my bicycle and walked to within a few yards of
the group of persons.

This group comprised one Japanese Marine holding a rifle
and operating the mechanism and 3 or 4 Japanese in foreign style
dress. After the shot was fired another Japanese Marine came
from the direction of Changping Road corner on the east side of
Kiaochow Road. I then left and went home. At the time the shot
was fired there were no pedestrians in the immediate vicinity.

At about 2.30p.m. I was again passing along Kiaochow
Road when two Police Officers came and questioned me.

This is my true statement.

我叫胡阿二，46岁，广东人，受雇于上海自来水公司，担任3号看守。1936年10月1日早上6点，我在胶州路565号公司大门上岗。

1936年10月1日12点后不久，我看到一名手持步枪的日本水兵站在胶州路西边584号对面。随后，四名日本男子走近他，我知道他们是胶州路601号日本学校的教师。

随后我看到他们与水兵交谈，当时水兵将步枪背在肩上。接着水兵双手持枪并进行操作，四名教师在旁观看。随后我听到一声枪响，从那群人的举动我知道是水兵开的枪。之后他们都离开了。没有其他水兵对枪声作出反应。

枪响时，附近没有中国人，只有一名邮递员在胶州路西侧靠近我的地方。

我认为这声枪响是意外发出的，我确信它不是朝任何人方向发射的。

此乃真实陈述。

胡阿二画押。

Sir,
At 1.15p.m. 1/10/36 S.I. Nakano received a telephone
message from J.P.C. 159 to the effect that a Japanese Marine
had fired a shot on Kiaochow Road. J.P.C. 159 did not witness
the firing; but had gathered the information from the Marines.
D.S. Mori was called from Lootoo Road by Charge Room
Sgt. and he, with C.D.S. 202 made immediate enquiries. D.S. Mori
contacted Chief Warrant Officer Sonohata with two Marines at
the scene.
At 1.45p.m. the undersigned, on arrival at the station
was informed of the incident by the Charge Room Sgt. and
immediately proceeded to the scene meeting both C.D.S. 202 and
D.S. Mori en route.
Inquiries revealed that a Japanese Marine with his rifle
'slung' on his shoulder was standing on the West pavement of
Kiaochow Road outside the wall of the Japanese school, directly
opposite the garage of house No. 584 Kiaochow Road. (The Marines
are employed as guard to the school and to afford protection to
the school children). He was then approached by four school
teachers who entered into conversation with him. The Marine
then took his rifle in his hands and was showing same to the
four teachers and operating the mechanism, when a shot was fired
which struck the wall of house 584 Kiaochow Road, (directly opposite
about 2 feet above the garage door (about 10 feet from the ground)
The wall is about 1 foot thick and the bullet penetrated
to a depth of approximately 1½ inches only, whilst this hole was
being probed for the bullet, same was picked up by S.I. Nakano
from the roadway. The bullet was 'mushroomed' and is consistent
with one fired under above conditions.

制作人 ____ 副巡官里德（Read）。____ 转呈人 ___

先生，
1936年10月1日下午1时15分，巡长中野（Nakano）接到来自日本警察岗亭159号（J.P.C. 159）的电话消息，称一名日本海军陆战队员在胶州路开了一枪。日本警察岗亭159号并未目击开枪过程；但该信息是从海军陆战队员处获悉的。值班室警佐从禄通路由召来巡佐森（Mori），他与刑事侦缉警员202号（C.D.S. 202）立即展开查询。巡佐森在现场与两名海军陆战队员及准尉园畑（Sonohata）取得了联系。
下午1时45分，卑职抵达捕房后，经值班室警佐告知此事，随即前往现场，途中遇见刑事侦缉警员202号和巡佐森。
经查，一名日本海军陆战队员将步枪“背”在肩上，站在胶州路西侧人行道上，位于日本学校围墙外，正对胶州路584号住宅的车库。（海军陆战队员受雇为学校警卫，并负责保护学童）。随后，四名学校教师走近并与他交谈。该海军陆战队员随即双手持枪，向四名教师展示并操作枪械机构，此时走火一发，子弹击中胶州路584号住宅的墙壁，（正对面，约在车库门上方2英尺处（距地面约10英尺））。墙体厚约1英尺，子弹仅穿透约1½英寸深，在探查弹孔寻找子弹时，巡长中野从路面上捡起了该子弹。子弹呈“蘑菇状”变形，符合在上述条件下发射的特征。

oo Ah [illegible], watchman No. 3, of Shanghai Water Works was
on duty at the Water Works Gate No. 565 Kiaochow Road and was
an eye witness to the shooting. After arrangements had been
made for him to be relieved, he was brought to the station and
a statement was taken, same is attached and his version is as
shown above.
He was questioned on the point of 'Chinese in the vicinity'
and as he shows in his statement, none other than a postman were
in the near vicinity and the shot was not fired at, or to inti-
midate, any person.
This part of Kiaochow Road has little vehicle and pedes-
trian traffic.
The fact that a postman (No. 659) had witnessed this
incident was revealed by D.C. & D.P.C. who personally visited
the scene. The postman has been traced as attached to Bubbling
Well Office and resides at 3191 Robison Road. Inquiries at
Bubbling Well Office reveal he is not on duty again today, whilst
enquiries at his home (from his wife) show that he has told her,
he is on duty. This is probably a domestic lie. His present
whereabouts are therefore unknown, but when located, he will be
requested to make a statement.
Chief Warrant Officer Sonohata was visited at 2.45 p.m.
at Toyoda Cotton Mill, 200 Jessfield Road (where the marines are
quartered) by the undersigned in company with D.S. Mori.
It was learnt that the shot had been fired by 1st class
seaman K. Taneda and that his rifle was of a repeating type.
It was also learnt that 8 to 10 marines are employed on this
school duty and that on the completion of same, they clear their
rifles of ammunition.

oo Ah [原文不清]，上海自来水公司第3号更夫，当时正在胶州路565号自来水公司大门执勤，是此次枪击事件的目击者。在安排他人接替其岗位后，他被带至捕房并录供，供词附后，其陈述如上所示。
就“附近是否有中国人”这一要点对其进行了讯问，正如他在供词中所述，附近除了一名邮差外并无其他人，且开枪并非针对或恐吓任何人。
胶州路该路段的车辆和行人交通量很少。
副巡长及副助理巡长（D.C. & D.P.C.）亲自走访现场后，发现一名邮差（659号）目击了此事件。经查，该邮差隶属于静安寺分局（Bubbling Well Office），居住在罗别根路（Robison Road）3191号。向静安寺分局查询得知，他今天不再当值，而向其住所查询（从其妻子处得知）显示，他告诉妻子他在当值。这可能是一个家庭内部的谎言。因此，他目前的下落不明，但一旦找到，将要求他提供供词。
下午2时45分，卑职与巡佐森一同前往杰斯菲尔德路（Jessfield Road）200号丰田纱厂（Toyoda Cotton Mill）（海军陆战队员驻扎地）拜访了准尉园畑（Sonohata）。
获悉开枪者为上等水兵谷田 K.（K. Taneda），其步枪为连发式。
还获悉有8至10名海军陆战队员执行此项学校警卫任务，且在任务结束后，他们会清空步枪中的弹药。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
One shot accidentally fired from the rifle of Japanese Marine on North Szechuen Road.
At 11.20 a.m. 26/9/36, J.P.C. 30 reported through street telephone box No. 4 that a Japanese Marine had accidentally fired one round from his rifle whilst on duty at N. Szechuen and Dukong Roads corner.
Inspector Jefferson and party proceeded to scene where it was ascertained that 1st class Seaman, K. Seyo, attached to the Japanese Naval Landing Party Headquarters, Kiangwan Road, who was on duty at the above mentioned place and was standing on East side of N. Szechuen Road, outside the Isis Theatre, holding his rifle at the "Port" when he pressed the trigger, accidentally firing one round which penetrated the signboard of the Kwang Hung (廣盛) Foodshop, No. 522 N. Szechuen Road., this signboard is approx. 20 feet high, then struck the wall of the building.
A search made on the upstairs verandah and on the ground in the immediate vicinity failed to locate the bullet.
Inquiries also failed to locate any injured person.
Questioned by J.D.S. 51 Hasuo, 1st class Seaman, K. Seyo stated that his rifle was loaded and he was under the impression that the safety catch was on, but after he had accidentally fired the round, he examined his rifle and found the safety catch off.

1936年9月26日上午11时20分，日本警察岗亭80号（J.P.C. 80）通过4号街头电话亭报告，一名日本海军陆战队员在北四川路与朱恭路（Jukong Roads）转角执勤时，意外从步枪中射出一发子弹。

协助
中国当局。

1936年9月25日下午1时30分，应居住在斯科特路（Scott Road）旁周子里（Cheu Ts Lee，音译）29号的岳子良（Yue Ts Liang，音译）的请求，特别巡捕397号（S.P.C. 397）将一名中国男性聋哑乞丐从斯科特路近北四川路处带至捕房，前者指控后者偷窃其装有课本的小皮箱，总价值1.50元。
按“C”区副巡官指令，采集指纹后移交公安局（P.S.B.）。日报 杂项 67/36。

协助
法国警方。

1936年9月26日凌晨12时30分，日本警佐96号（J.P.S. 96）将俄罗斯人 V.B. 弗林（V.B. Flin），24岁，无业，居住在坦南特·德·拉·图尔路（Route Tennant de la Tour）290号，带至捕房。他于1936年9月26日凌晨12时15分在北四川路近朱恭路处将其逮捕，当时观察到其驾驶11648号汽车，并在伊西斯大戏院附近试图启动车辆时险些造成事故。经查，他无驾驶汽车执照。
中央巡捕2719号（C.P.C. 2719）（捕房司机）将汽车从北四川路开至捕房。
经查询，怀疑该汽车系被盗，后经证实，车主 W. J. 耶顿（W. J. Yetton）先生（通讯处：博物馆路38号 Reiss Massey & Co. Ltd.）已被找到，他称其汽车在盖司康路（Rue Bourgeat）国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）外被盗。被告被处以拘留令，并出庭受审于中央会审公廨（C.S.D. Court），还押至1936年9月29日，届时法国警方将申请引渡被告。日报 杂项 65/36。
